## Task — wrangler pages deploy main to multivox

**Goal:** Bring main `2012a84` (squash of #67 env-lift + #68 founder-union) live on multivox.pages.dev → mvox.eu.

**Why now:** PO is troubleshooting a navbar hydration issue on mvox.eu and the current build chunks (`app.Bpbjc7CB.js` / `start.y624_gjC.js`) are still session-22's CHORE-66 deploy. mvox is not Git-connected to CF Pages (GH #44 open) so main pushes don't auto-deploy. Manual wrangler push is the only path.

## Procedure (per memory `project_wrangler_deploy_auth` + `project_cf_pages_wrangler_vars`)

```bash
cd /home/michelek/workspace && \
  git checkout main && \
  git pull --ff-only && \
  pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && \
  pnpm build
```

Verify build artifact: `.svelte-kit/cloudflare/` should be populated.

Then:

```bash
set -a; . ~/.config/mvox/credentials.env; set +a
pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --project-name=multivox --branch=main
```

(`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` is pre-stashed in credentials.env. The `set -a` pattern is the workaround per memory — wrangler login needs xdg-utils which isn't installed.)

## After deploy

1. Capture the deploy URL (something like `<hash>.multivox.pages.dev`)
2. Verify health: `curl -sI https://multivox.pages.dev/` and `curl -sI https://mvox.eu/` — both should return 200 with `x-sveltekit-page: true`
3. Verify build hash rotated: `curl -s https://mvox.eu/ | grep -oE 'app\.[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js' | head -1` should NOT be `app.Bpbjc7CB.js` anymore. Different chunk hash = new deploy is live.
4. Report deploy URL + new build chunk + curl status to team-lead.
